messages:
anita: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API roadmap for embeddings + rerank. Customer asks are stacking up, need to pick bets. can we do a 30m thread?
liam: +1. TL;DR from CS: lower rerank unit cost, faster index updates (minutes -> seconds), and a stable p95 under load.
maya: suggested slate: 1) prefix/KV caching for embeddings to cut cost, 2) a quantized rerank-only model family for cheaper reranks, 3) rollout & canary plan with a few power users.
sam: is it reasonable to aim for both caching and quantized models in one quarter? curious about infra lift for cache invalidation + embedding versioning.
elena: short list of launch criteria idea: `p95_rerank <= 120ms @ 50qps`, `cost_per_rerank <= $0.003` (ballpark), embedding freshness < 30s for streaming updates, automated rollback on quality regression.
anita: good checklist. also need acceptance metrics for quality: relative MRR >= 0.98 vs baseline, and human eval delta < 1% false positives on ranking.
product-bot: created RD-2345 (q2-embed-cache) and RD-2346 (q2-quant-rerank). see https://redwood.internal/rd/2345
liam: infra blockers: need prefix cache layer (can be memcached/redis) + per-customer invalidation API, plus routing rules to route rerank traffic to quantized variant. autoscaler needs to be model-aware.
maya: prioritized customer list for canary: AcmeCorp, EduDesk, NovaSearch. they have the highest rerank volume and will report regressions fast.
sam: ops requirements: runbooks for rollback, SLO alert thresholds, and a tracing hook to attribute latency to model vs network vs db.
elena: I can draft a launch checklist — will include monitoring dashboards, evaluation harness, canary gating, and post-launch quality alerts. expect a PR by Friday.
anita: proposed scope decisions: M1 (must-have): embed cache + metrics + simple canary with AcmeCorp; M2 (stretch): quantized rerank family + autoscaler + broader canary. keep M1 small to ship end of quarter.
liam: timeline sanity check: M1 infra + api ~4 weeks (RD-2345), canary 2 weeks, M2 quant + tuning ~6 weeks after M1. total feels tight but doable if we freeze scope now.
maya: customer asks mapped to scope: Acme wants cache + 60s freshness, EduDesk wants cheaper rerank ASAP (push M2 higher), NovaSearch wants faster index updates (we may need incremental embedding pipelines).
sam: note: quantization work also requires new perf benchmarks and offline evals to detect rank-flipping. allocate research time.
elena: draft okrs to attach: "Reduce hosted rerank cost by 30% for top 5 customers" and "Maintain rerank p95 <= 120ms during 99th percentile traffic".
anita: action items: 1) elena draft launch checklist & okrs by Fri; 2) liam scope infra tickets + estimate by Tue; 3) maya align with Acme/EduDesk + get sample logs; 4) sam draft runbooks & bench plan. anyone object?
liam: no objections. one ask — include a rollback SLA in canary plan: auto-fallback to baseline model if eval metric drops >2%.
maya: noted. i will confirm customer availability for canary next week. :thumbsup:
anita: thanks all. I'll turn this into a short PR and pin the M1/M2 scopes. we can iterate after estimates. :rocket:
